name: Password Sign-In
summary: Executes anonymous password authentication through the stable application flow boundary and emits canonical Success, Rejected, or Locked Out outcomes.
notes: The generated client and REST route remain stable; canonical transition selection is internal to the application flow.
Invalid password and unknown account converge on Rejected publicly while retaining distinct authentication-log evidence.
Failures outside the three modeled outcomes are not silently reclassified by the flow handler.

sourceReferences.note: AuthenticationFlowService.LoginWithPasswordAsync is the stable application front door and validates the emitted transition.
Handler classifies manager results into the three canonical transitions.
